correctness.rationale: Exact four-component eigenphase decomposition yields an all-real-q modular-four contradiction to PST. Kronecker density on the odd subsequence proves PGST for transcendental q. For rational q, trace-phase periodicity forces the odd denominator, rational-square discriminants give closed phase orbits, and an irrational discriminant rotation yields sufficiency. Exact standalone rational matrix checks and finite witnesses were independently replayed; no infinite theorem is inferred from finite computation.

value.rationale: A structurally natural minimal five-vertex transport network with two nonadjacent twins admits a stark control-support boundary: all-real hub-only PST obstruction, generic-transcendental PGST, and sharp odd-denominator/nonsquare-discriminant criterion for every rational hub strength. This is a complete nonroutine classification for rational controls with a concrete exact-vs-approximate physical distinction, not merely a table of low-dimensional instances.
